GenAiPlugin.description: Track partner/vendor delays, SLA risk, response evidence, and approved follow-up requests.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Use Partner as the core primitive. A lab, laundry, insurer, airline, supplier, payment processor, and vendor are all partners.
Identify SLA window, delay reason, response evidence, fallback option, approval need, and communication target.
Vendor email or partner follow-up is protected. Propose it, but do not execute without approval.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic for external dependency delays, supplier issues, insurer or processor follow-up, SLA risk, and partner evidence updates.
